meta.title: Sigma Channel - Sigma CX

hero.title: All customer touchpoints in a *single solution*
hero.lead: Inbound and outbound in one place, with intelligence, security and scalability.

flows.title: Customizable flows
flows.body: Create and implement custom interaction flows for your business objectives, in five steps.

steps.title: Campaign
steps.body: Define the objective of the action.

steps.title: Channel
steps.body: Select where the campaign will be distributed: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and more.

steps.title: Automated dispatch
steps.body: Set up personalized, scheduled sends for each audience.

steps.title: Engagement
steps.body: Monitor responses and interactions in real time.

steps.title: Dynamic adjustments
steps.body: Optimize the flow during the campaign based on the results.

automate.title: Automate your customer's daily routine

automate.lead: Appointment reminders, purchase confirmations and campaigns, on autopilot.
